title: SHORTCUT FRAMES: cmd+k, cmd+k, shift+cmd+p, cmd+p (warm-idle-dark-anim-on), real HID keys, recorded every frame
why: Lawrence 2026-11-02: cmd+t and cmd shift l, literally all the keyboard shortcuts, open the new tab instantly, the frame of; videos, pixel perfect. The judge (scripts/cmux-next/shortcut-frames/judge.py) counts display refreshes from each HID key-down to the first changed frame and checks the frames after it.
